note: Current-release digital-engine registration baseline after implementing the shared post-clear Mystics Aftermath timing for Grave Ward, Soul for Soul, and Necromancy. Current Action parity remains 74/74. Current battle parity is 76/113, leaving 37 unsupported battle surfaces. These effects resolve after battle cards clear, under the normal shared-timing procedure, with current Graveyard state re-evaluated after each effect. Grave Ward recovers one other Gambit, Soul for Soul optionally exchanges a Hand card with one other Gambit, and Necromancy chooses up to three non-Necromancy Graveyard cards before moving the entire Hand to the Graveyard and returning the chosen cards. Deferred Arcane handlers now also honor Monastery suppression before registration. Registration remains a surface census, not a claim that every historically registered behavior has been fully revalidated against all v0.7.2 semantic changes.
